catatan: Seluruh ambang berasal dari literatur klinis + baseline personal yang dihitung dari data sensor pemakai sendiri. Tidak ada angka yang diisi manual. Angka klinis hidup di blok `literatur`, bobot sinyal di blok `bobot`. Wajib divalidasi dokter sebelum dipakai untuk keputusan medis.

spo2.sumber: GOLD 2024 Report (LTOT PaO2<=55 mmHg ~ SpO2<=88%, angkanya ada di dalam PDF laporan); BTS Guideline 2017, Thorax 72(Suppl 1):ii1 (target 88-92% pada risiko hiperkapnia, SaO2<90% = gagal napas tipe 1); StatPearls NBK482316 Hypoxia and Hypoxemia 2024 (band ringan 90-94%, sedang 80-89%)
spo2.sumber_en: GOLD 2024 Report (LTOT PaO2<=55 mmHg ~ SpO2<=88%, the figure is inside the report PDF); BTS Guideline 2017, Thorax 72(Suppl 1):ii1 (target 88-92% when hypercapnia is a risk, SaO2<90% = type 1 respiratory failure); StatPearls NBK482316 Hypoxia and Hypoxemia 2024 (mild band 90-94%, moderate 80-89%)

desaturasi_personal.sumber: AASM 2012 J Clin Sleep Med 8(5):597 (hipopnea = desaturasi >=3% dari baseline); Agarwal 2023 Lung India (desaturasi 6MWT >=4% dianggap bermakna); ISO 80601-2-61 ed2 2017 (akurasi pulse oximeter, direkoknisi FDA)
desaturasi_personal.sumber_en: AASM 2012 J Clin Sleep Med 8(5):597 (hypopnoea = desaturation >=3% from baseline); Agarwal 2023 Lung India (6MWT desaturation >=4% counted as significant); ISO 80601-2-61 ed2 2017 (pulse oximeter accuracy, recognised by the FDA)

laju_napas.sumber: NEWS2 RCP 2017 (RR 21-24 = 2 poin, >=25 = 3 poin; baris skor ada di PDF laporan); Farmer 2024 Chest (RR >20-24 meski terapi standar = pertimbangkan NIV, mengutip ERS/ATS); Blouet 2018 Int J Chron Obstruct Pulmon Dis (RR naik mendahului eksaserbasi)
laju_napas.sumber_en: NEWS2 RCP 2017 (RR 21-24 = 2 points, >=25 = 3 points; the scoring row is in the report PDF); Farmer 2024 Chest (RR >20-24 despite standard therapy = consider NIV, citing ERS/ATS); Blouet 2018 Int J Chron Obstruct Pulmon Dis (RR rises ahead of an exacerbation)

detak_jantung.sumber: AHA WatchLearnLive (takikardia >100 bpm); Hawthorne 2022 Respir Res 23:102 (prodrome: HR +8,1 bpm dan RR +2,0 hingga 3 hari sebelum eksaserbasi); Montenegro 2026 JMIR Med Inform (tinjauan yang mengutipnya); Sanchez-Morillo 2026 Bioengineering 13(10):1195
detak_jantung.sumber_en: AHA WatchLearnLive (tachycardia >100 bpm); Hawthorne 2022 Respir Res 23:102 (prodrome: HR +8.1 bpm and RR +2.0 up to 3 days before an exacerbation); Montenegro 2026 JMIR Med Inform (review citing it); Sanchez-Morillo 2026 Bioengineering 13(10):1195

hrv_rmssd.sumber: Umetani 1998 J Am Coll Cardiol 31:59-65 (HRV 24 jam turun tercepat mulai dekade keenam; angka RMSSD per dekade tidak terbaca dari abstrak, jadi floor 20 ms dipakai sebagai pembulatan bawah); Shaffer & Ginsberg 2017 Front Public Health 5:230 (RMSSD 5 menit supine 42+/-15 ms); Tegegne 2019 Eur J Prev Cardiol (referensi RMSSD populasi); Chalmers 2014 Front Psychiatry 5:80 (HRV rendah pada gangguan kecemasan); Kim 2018 Psychiatry Investig (stres akut menurunkan HRV); pita Garmin HRV +/-10% dan -25% dari baseline pribadi
hrv_rmssd.sumber_en: Umetani 1998 J Am Coll Cardiol 31:59-65 (24-hour HRV falls fastest from the sixth decade; per-decade RMSSD values cannot be read off the abstract, so 20 ms is used as a lower floor); Shaffer & Ginsberg 2017 Front Public Health 5:230 (5-minute supine RMSSD 42+/-15 ms); Tegegne 2019 Eur J Prev Cardiol (population RMSSD reference); Chalmers 2014 Front Psychiatry 5:80 (low HRV in anxiety disorders); Kim 2018 Psychiatry Investig (acute stress lowers HRV); Garmin HRV band +/-10% and -25% from personal baseline

tidur.sumber: AASM/SRS 2015, Sleep 38:843 (>=7 jam dewasa); ICSD-3 AASM 2014 + kriteria Perlis (efisiensi <85% terverifikasi di literatur insomnia, WASO >=31 mnt adalah konvensi klasifikasi); Ben Simon 2020 Nat Hum Behav 4:100 (tidur terfragmentasi -> kecemasan hari berikutnya)
tidur.sumber_en: AASM/SRS 2015, Sleep 38:843 (>=7 hours for adults); ICSD-3 AASM 2014 + Perlis criteria (efficiency <85% verified in the insomnia literature; WASO >=31 min is a classification convention); Ben Simon 2020 Nat Hum Behav 4:100 (fragmented sleep -> next-day anxiety)

udara_dingin.sumber: Hanstock 2020 Front Sports Act Living (satu studi dalam tabelnya: delta FEV1 -19+/-4,9% pada udara dingin-kering; kelembapan rendah lebih kuat daripada suhu); Van Gerven 2012 Laryngoscope 122:2615 (udara -10 C dan RH <10% selama 15 menit, uji positif = PNIF turun >20%); Graudenz 2006 J Allergy Clin Immunol 118:1126 (selisih suhu chamber 12 C memicu respons nasal); Kwon 2016 Allergy Asthma Immunol Res (angin kencang + kelembapan rendah menaikkan kunjungan IGD asma)
udara_dingin.sumber_en: Hanstock 2020 Front Sports Act Living (one study in its table: delta FEV1 -19+/-4.9% in cold-dry air; low humidity weighs more than temperature); Van Gerven 2012 Laryngoscope 122:2615 (-10 C air at RH <10% for 15 minutes, positive test = PNIF drop >20%); Graudenz 2006 J Allergy Clin Immunol 118:1126 (a 12 C chamber difference triggers a nasal response); Kwon 2016 Allergy Asthma Immunol Res (high wind plus low humidity raises asthma ER visits)

partikulat.sumber: US EPA/AirNow AQI Technical Assistance Document Tabel 6 (PM2.5 24 jam 35,5-55,4 ug/m3 = Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups); WHO Global Air Quality Guidelines 2021 (24-jam 15 ug/m3); DeVries 2017 COPD 14:113 (+2,5% kunjungan IGD/rawat COPD per +10 ug/m3, eksposur jangka pendek)
partikulat.sumber_en: US EPA/AirNow AQI Technical Assistance Document Table 6 (PM2.5 24-hour 35.5-55.4 ug/m3 = Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups); WHO Global Air Quality Guidelines 2021 (24-hour 15 ug/m3); DeVries 2017 COPD 14:113 (+2.5% COPD ER visits/admissions per +10 ug/m3, short-term exposure)

aktivitas.sumber: ACSM Position Stand 2011 (Garber), Med Sci Sports Exerc 43:1334 (>=30 menit/hari pada >=5 hari/minggu); Weiler 2016 J Allergy Clin Immunol 138:1292 (tinjauan bronkokonstriksi akibat olahraga); Hanstock 2020 (memburuk pada udara dingin dan kering)
aktivitas.sumber_en: ACSM Position Stand 2011 (Garber), Med Sci Sports Exerc 43:1334 (>=30 min/day on >=5 days/week); Weiler 2016 J Allergy Clin Immunol 138:1292 (review of exercise-induced bronchoconstriction); Hanstock 2020 (worse in cold, dry air)

siklus.sumber: Alzueta 2022 Int J Womens Health 14:491 (HR naik pada luteal tengah-akhir, n=26, HR saat tidur); de Jager 2026 Sports Medicine (time-domain HRV 3-9% lebih rendah di akhir siklus); Johnson 2026 medRxiv preprint (pergeseran absolut RHR 1,5-4 bpm)
siklus.sumber_en: Alzueta 2022 Int J Womens Health 14:491 (HR rises in mid-to-late luteal, n=26, sleeping HR); de Jager 2026 Sports Medicine (time-domain HRV 3-9% lower late in the cycle); Johnson 2026 medRxiv preprint (absolute RHR shift 1.5-4 bpm)

offset_suhu_personal.sumber: Offset struktural terhadap ambang personal, meniru berjenjangnya protokol provokasi udara dingin (PNIF turun >=20% = positif).
offset_suhu_personal.sumber_en: Structural offsets against the personal threshold, mirroring the tiers of a cold-air provocation protocol (PNIF drop >=20% = positive).

dinamis.sumber: median + MAD (Iglewicz & Hoaglin 1993, modifikasi z = 0.6745*(x-median)/MAD, outlier |z|>3.5); jendela trailing 28 malam mengikuti Oura HRV Balance (14 hari vs baseline 3 bulan); Garmin Training Readiness memakai rata-rata 7 hari dalam pita baseline pribadi; Wu 2021 JMIR Mhealth Uhealth 9(5):e22591 (prediksi eksaserbasi 7 hari ke depan)
dinamis.sumber_en: median + MAD (Iglewicz & Hoaglin 1993, modified z = 0.6745*(x-median)/MAD, outlier |z|>3.5); trailing 28-night window following Oura HRV Balance (14 days against a 3-month baseline); Garmin Training Readiness uses a 7-day mean inside the personal baseline band; Wu 2021 JMIR Mhealth Uhealth 9(5):e22591 (exacerbation prediction up to 7 days ahead)

pembelajaran_ambang_dingin.sumber: Ambang personal = suhu lingkungan TERWARMAT di mana reaksi fisiologis tercatat (prinsip provocation testing; PNIF turun >=20% dianggap positif, Van Gerven 2012). Sebelum 3 kejadian, angka dicampur dengan band literatur.
pembelajaran_ambang_dingin.sumber_en: Personal threshold = the WARMEST ambient temperature at which a physiological reaction was recorded (provocation testing principle; a PNIF drop >=20% counts as positive, Van Gerven 2012). Below 3 recorded events the figure is blended with the literature band.
pembelajaran_ambang_dingin.catatan: Kejadian reaksi dicari sendiri dari riwayat sampel siklus, bukan dari laporan manual.
pembelajaran_ambang_dingin.catatan_en: Reaction events are found in the cycle sample history itself, never from a manual report.

Bronkitis.WASPADA: Pantau napas. Tunda aktivitas berat sampai laju napas dan saturasi kembali ke baseline-mu.
Bronkitis.PERHATIAN: Duduk tegak, pursed-lip breathing. Cek inhaler/obat. Suhu {suhu}C dan PM2.5 {pm25} ug/m3 ikut dinilai.
Bronkitis.BAHAYA: Istirahat total. Saturasi {spo2}% vs baseline {spo2_baseline}%. Hubungi dokter/IGD bila sesak memberat.

Anxiety.WASPADA: Napas 4-7-8 selama 3 menit. HRV-mu turun ke {hrv} ms.
Anxiety.PERHATIAN: Grounding 5-4-3-2-1. Jauhkan pemicu. Tidur {tidur_jam} jam dan HRV {hrv} ms ikut menekan.
Anxiety.BAHAYA: Duduk, minum air hangat, napas dalam. HR {hr} bpm vs baseline {hr_baseline} bpm. Hubungi support bila tidak mereda.

Alergi Dingin.WASPADA: Pakai jaket sebelum keluar. Suhu {suhu}C, angin {angin} m/s, RH {rh}%.
Alergi Dingin.PERHATIAN: Lapisan hangat + tutup hidung-mulut agar udara terhangatkan. Suhu {suhu}C di bawah ambang personalmu {ambang_dingin}C.
Alergi Dingin.BAHAYA: Tetap di dalam ruangan. Suhu {suhu}C dengan angin {angin} m/s. Pakai pakaian hangat berlapis.

Bronkitis.WASPADA: Keep an eye on your breathing. Delay heavy activity until breathing rate and saturation are back to your baseline.
Bronkitis.PERHATIAN: Sit upright, pursed-lip breathing. Check your inhaler/medication. Temperature {suhu}C and PM2.5 {pm25} ug/m3 are part of this reading too.
Bronkitis.BAHAYA: Complete rest. Saturation {spo2}% against a {spo2_baseline}% baseline. Call a doctor or the ER if breathlessness worsens.

Anxiety.WASPADA: 4-7-8 breathing for 3 minutes. Your HRV has dropped to {hrv} ms.
Anxiety.PERHATIAN: 5-4-3-2-1 grounding. Move away from triggers. {tidur_jam} hours of sleep and {hrv} ms HRV are weighing on this too.
Anxiety.BAHAYA: Sit down, drink warm water, breathe deeply. HR {hr} bpm against a {hr_baseline} bpm baseline. Reach out for support if it does not settle.

Alergi Dingin.WASPADA: Put on a jacket before going out. Temperature {suhu}C, wind {angin} m/s, RH {rh}%.
Alergi Dingin.PERHATIAN: Warm layers plus cover nose and mouth so the air warms first. Temperature {suhu}C is below your personal threshold {ambang_dingin}C.
Alergi Dingin.BAHAYA: Stay indoors. Temperature {suhu}C with {angin} m/s wind. Wear warm, layered clothing.

sumber_riset.catatan: Setiap tautan di daftar ini dibuka dan dicocokkan dengan isinya. Entri bertanda perlu dicek adalah tautan yang benar tapi penerbitnya menolak pembacaan otomatis (403/reCAPTCHA/redirect berbayar), sehingga angkanya harus dibaca manusia sebelum dipakai untuk keputusan medis. Tiga kutipan lama yang tidak berhasil diverifikasi di PubMed maupun Europe PMC sudah diganti dengan sumber yang benar-benar ada, dan angka yang hanya muncul di abstrak tidak dipakai sebagai ambang.
sumber_riset.catatan_en: Every link in this list was opened and matched against its contents. Entries marked for manual checking are real links whose publisher refuses automated reading (403/reCAPTCHA/paid redirect), so their figures need a human before any medical decision. Three older citations that could not be verified in PubMed or Europe PMC were replaced with sources that genuinely exist, and figures that only appear in an abstract are never used as a threshold.
